args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the deployment of v2.3.1 (error rate 18%). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification: service is healthy, error rate 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure TBD.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production. (v2.3.1-rc was healthy but only ever in staging, so it was not a valid rollback target.)
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
